articles.title: Current Status & Event Overview
articles.content:

Status: CLOSED.

articles.title: Lobster Group Buy - Timeline & Current Status
articles.content:
LOBSTER GROUP BUY STATUS
Last updated: September 15, 2026

The Lobster GB is CLOSED to new 0rders.

The GB closed August 11.

Fulfillment is actively in progress.

ORIGINAL TIMELINE

The original estimate was approximately 6–12 weeks from the end of the GB 0rdering window.

Earlier 0rders are generally fulfilled before later 0rders.

Because this was a very large GB, packages will continue going out over an extended period.

DELAYS

The original timeline assumed:
- approximately 2 weeks for p3ps production
- approximately 4 weeks for sh1pping

Since then, there have been delays caused by:
- international sh1pping challenges
- changes in transport routes
- increased cust0ms/seizure risk in the U.S.

As of September 10, approximately 30% of the entire GB 0rder had been sh1pped.

The entire GB had not yet been fully dispatched.

UPDATED ESTIMATE

There is currently no precise final ETA.

The full GB sh1pment was expected to be dispatched during September.

Once all products are moving:
- UK and EU: expect several additional weeks.
- United States: expect approximately 6–8 weeks to finish all U.S. sh1pments because of the very large number of 0rders.

These are estimates, not guarantees.

0rders are generally processed approximately first-0rdered, first-out, depending on which products are physically available.

LATEST U.S. UPDATE — SEPTEMBER 14

Approximately the first 40 HCG and C@rtalax packages were boxed.
Tracking was added to the website.
Those packages were scheduled to be dropped off.

A large amount of p3ps was scheduled to begin arriving, with additional shipments expected over approximately 2–3 weeks.

H.Geee.H. was expected later, but there is no guaranteed date.

The latest informal estimate was that the overall process was approximately two weeks behind earlier expectations.

Do not present the two-week delay as a guarantee.

articles.title: Lobster GB - Shipping Updates
articles.content:
LOBSTER GROUP BUY SH1PPING
Last updated: September 15, 2026

IMPORTANT:
These updates apply specifically to the Lobster GB.

UK AND EU

There has been movement of p3ps toward UK and EU warehouses.

Local 0rders are expected to begin going out as products arrive at those warehouses.

Some d1rect 0rders have already sh1pped.

Members will receive tracking when their individual 0rder is actually dispatched.

UNITED STATES

HCG has begun arriving.

C@rtalax from Changsa has already been received.

HCG + C@rtalax-only 0rders are beginning to sh1p.

Approximately 40–50 of these early packages are being processed first.

H.Geee.H.

H.Geee.H. is still in transit by sea.

As of the latest update, it had been at sea for nearly three weeks.

It is expected to reach port soon, but there is no guaranteed arrival date.

Do not state a firm ETA.

P3PS ROUTE CHANGE

Boat sh1pping for p3ps is no longer working as planned.

The p3ps had not reached port through the original boat route.

Sh1pping is therefore being moved to air routes.

Air-route tracking numbers are now being received.

Some d1rect 0rders have already gone out.

Additional tracking is appearing for:
- UK
- EU
- United States

Sh1pping will continue progressively over a significant period because this was a very large GB.

TRACKING

When an individual 0rder sh1ps:
- tracking is sent by email
- tracking is also added at https://peptegridy.com

This applies to both:
- d1rect 0rders
- local warehouse 0rders

If a member does NOT have tracking yet:
There is no additional individual status available.

The correct answer is that their 0rder is still waiting in the fulfillment process.

Do not invent or estimate individual package status.

FULFILLMENT ORDER

0rders generally begin from the earliest 0rders first.

Fulfillment also depends on which products are physically available.

If Tegridy has all products for a particular 0rder on hand, that 0rder may be processed.

Once all inventory is available, fulfillment proceeds approximately earliest-to-latest.

articles.title: Lobster GB - Order and Address Changes
articles.content:
LOBSTER GROUP BUY CHANGES

CAN I CHANGE MY 0RDER?

No.

Changes to the contents of a Lobster GB 0rder were only possible before the GB closed.

The cutoff was August 11.

Product selections, quantities, or other 0rder contents cannot now be changed.

CAN I CHANGE MY SH1PPING ADDRESS?

Possibly.

A sh1pping address may be changed only if the 0rder has NOT already been packed or sh1pped.

Members needing an address change should contact an admin by DM as soon as possible.

Address changes are not guaranteed if the warehouse is already packing or processing the 0rder.

Tegridy is not responsible for an 0rder going to the original address if the request was made too late in the fulfillment process.

articles.title: Lobster GB - Testing and COAs
articles.content:
LOBSTER GROUP BUY TESTING AND COAs

Testing for the Lobster GB includes:
- Mass
- Purity
- Endotoxins
- Sterility

H.Geee.H. additionally receives:
- Dimer testing

Customers are not charged separately for standard GB testing.

WHEN WILL COAs BE AVAILABLE?

Tegridy needs to receive the products in the United States before sending them for testing.

A request has been made for one k1t of each product to be sent early so COA testing can begin sooner.

However:
There is no guaranteed COA timeline.

Testing will be processed as quickly as possible once samples are available.

Some customers may receive their 0rders before the COAs are published.

Do not promise that COAs will be available before individual deliveries.

CURRENT COAs

Available COAs can be viewed at:
https://peptegridy.com/coas

T30 AND R30 SECOND-BATCH COAs

The second-batch T30 and R30 testing package was received by the lab on the Thursday before the September 15 update.

The COAs are currently pending.

Do not provide results until the official COAs are released.

CUSTOM COAs

Custom COAs were previously available during earlier GB 0rdering periods.

This option is NOT currently active.

articles.title: General Ordering, Payments & Announcements
articles.content:
TEGRIDY GENERAL 0RDERING, P@YMENT & ANNOUNCEMENT INFORMATION

WHERE DO I 0RDER?

The official website is:
https://peptegridy.com

ARE THERE MINIMUM 0RDERS?

Generally:
No.

Members may 0rder as little or as much as they like.

Minimum 0rder requirements apply only to specific d1rect sh1pment options.

GENERAL P@YMENT POLICY

Tegridy uses crypto for p@yment.

The following are normally accepted without an additional fee:
- USDC on Solana
- USDC on Ethereum

Other cryptocurrencies may normally be subject to a 5% swap fee.

CRYPTO HELP

Members unfamiliar with crypto should use the group's Crypto Help room for assistance.

The FAQ bot may explain which p@yment methods are accepted.

The bot must not invent:
- wallet addresses
- p@yment destinations
- transaction details
- p@yment confirmation status

Official p@yment addresses and instructions should only come from official Tegridy systems or admins.

SPECIFIC 0RDER OR P@YMENT ISSUES

If someone asks about:
- their personal p@yment
- whether their p@yment was received
- whether their 0rder was confirmed
- a missing 0rder
- a specific wallet transaction
- a specific customer account issue

The bot cannot verify these from the Knowledge Base.

The member should be directed to an admin for review.

NEXT GB INFORMATION

Official future GB information is published in the Announcements tab.

If there is no official announcement, the bot should not invent or speculate about:
- future products
- future pr1ces
- exact GB dates
- suppliers
- sh1pping terms
- p@yment rules

As of September 10, the only tentative future plan is a YuanTai + cosmetic raws GB for late September / early October.

No additional official details are currently available.

articles.title: Tegridy Terminology, Aliases & Preferred Wording
articles.content:
TEGRIDY TERMINOLOGY, ALIASES & PREFERRED WORDING

Members may intentionally use altered, abbreviated, or censored spellings.

The bot must understand normal spellings, abbreviations, and altered spellings as referring to the same concept when context makes that clear.

When the bot writes its OWN Tegridy-related replies, it should prefer the community-safe wording below.

UNDERSTANDING ALIASES

GB = Group Buy
Reta = Ret@ = Retatrutide
3lora = Elora = Elor@
SuperH = H.Geee.H.
HGH may refer to H.Geee.H. depending on context
p3ps / p3pts = peptides
f@ctory = factory
0rder = order
0rdering = ordering
p@yment = payment
pr1ce = price
s3ll = sell
b#ying = buying
k1t = kit
k1ts = kits
sh1pping = shipping
cust0mer = customer
d1rect = direct
C@rtalax = Cartalax

PREFERRED TEGRIDY OUTPUT WORDING

Use:
- Ret@
- Elor@
- H.Geee.H.
- p3ps
- f@ctory
- 0rder / 0rdering
- p@yment
- pr1ce
- s3ll
- b#ying
- k1t / k1ts
- sh1pping
- cust0mer
- d1rect
- C@rtalax

Do not correct members for using normal spellings.

Do not explain why alternate spellings are used.

These preferred spellings apply to Tegridy-related answers only.

For unrelated general-knowledge questions, use normal English spelling.
